Questions, answered straight

Do you guarantee views, subscribers, or rankings?

No — and be wary of anyone who does. We provide structured execution, tracking, and honest reporting. Your outcomes depend on your market, your offer, your creative, and how consistently you implement.

Is ad spend included in the management fee?

No. The management fee covers strategy, setup, creative direction, and reporting. Your ad spend is paid by you directly to Google or Meta, so you keep full control of the budget.

Can you get my Google Business Profile verified or ranked #1?

We help with optimization, documentation, and the legitimate appeal steps if a profile is suspended. We never promise verification approval or a ranking position, and we never use bypass tricks that could get your listing banned.

What’s included in AI filmmaking?

Everything from concept to final cut: reference images, storyboards, character sheets, prompt development, and editing. Character consistency is protected with identity-lock prompts and continuity checks. Tools such as Flow, Grok, Gemini, ElevenLabs, and Suno may be used — subscriptions and usage rights are clarified in your project scope.

Are AI product images real photographs?

No. They are AI-generated visuals created from your reference photos. You review and approve every image before it’s used, and we flag any limits on shape, materials, or label accuracy up front.

Do you post the same content everywhere?

No. The hook, dimensions, caption length, and call to action are adapted for each platform. Straight copy-paste cross-posting is avoided unless you specifically approve it.

What do you need from me to start?

Your brand assets, account access, and your goals. After booking, we send a simple checklist and define everyone’s responsibilities in writing.

How does billing work?

All prices are in USD. One-time projects are invoiced upfront, and delivery timelines start once we receive your assets. Monthly plans run on 30-day cycles.

Is there a discount right now?

Yes — we’re currently offering 25% off our services. Mention the 25% off offer when you enquire and we’ll apply it to your quote.

What if I’m not satisfied?

You get your money back. Our satisfaction guarantee covers our services: if you’re not satisfied with our service, we refund you.
